title: TestRunEpicFailsClosed fails at base: the gate-config read precedes the no-executor refusal
body: internal/cli's TestRunEpicFailsClosed expects `ticfac run-epic x` to exit 2 saying "no executor configured", but under `go test ./...` (cwd = package dir) reconcile first tries to read `.tick/runners.toml` under internal/cli, exits 1 on its absence, and the expected refusal is never reached. It fails identically at base commit 5e397e4bc376 with this tick's files removed, so the per-tick gate is red at base on this host.
